items.source:
Can be used as a functional interface (for example, with a lambda expression) for a simple
sharding key, or as a two-method interface when including a super sharding key as well.
items.translation: 可用作简单分片键的功能接口（例如，与 Lambda 表达式一起使用），或在使用超分片键时作为包含两个方法的接口。

items.source:
Determine the sharding key. This method returns the sharding key relevant to the current
context which will be used to obtain a direct shard connection.
items.translation: 确定分片键。此方法返回与当前上下文相关的分片键，该键将用于获取直接分片连接。

items.source:
Determine the super sharding key, if any. This method returns the super sharding key
relevant to the current context which will be used to obtain a direct shard connection.
items.translation: 确定超分片键（如果有的话）。此方法返回与当前上下文相关的超分片键，该键将用于获取直连分片连接。

items.source: SQLException - if an error occurs while obtaining the sharding key
items.translation: SQLException - 如果在获取分片键时发生错误

items.source: SQLException - if an error occurs while obtaining the super sharding key
items.translation: SQLException - 如果在获取主分片键时发生错误

items.source: the sharding key, or null if it is not available or cannot be determined
items.translation: 分片键，或者如果不可用或无法确定则为null。

items.source: the super sharding key, or null if it is not available or cannot be determined (the default)
items.translation: 超级分片键，或者如果不可用或无法确定则为null（默认值）

items.source: Determine the super sharding key, if any.
